# Changelog

## 1.0.0
- Initial release as ror2-plus: 52 new items and equipment on top of ClassicItemsReturns.
- 45 items and equipment require unlocking through achievements, based on Risk of Rain Returns (configurable).
- 156 void items: a void version of every white, green and red item that lacked one (base game, all DLCs and ror2-plus).
- New icons for every item: modelled in Blender with a matte, hand-painted style.
- 3D pickup models for all 208 new items and void items, baked in the same painted style as the icons.
- Items show up on survivors (first-pass placements).
- Logbook lore for every new item, equipment and void item.
- 4 new artifacts: Distortion, Spirit, Origin and Tempus.
- In-game settings through Risk of Options (optional).
- Carrara Marble gates, Dynamite Plunger sticks, Safeguard Lantern and Rotten Brain are now visible to every player in multiplayer.
- Art matched to the game's own assets: icons follow the vanilla stroke spec and tier colours, void items are reworked originals with nebula surfaces and pink glow like vanilla voids, and 3D models use vanilla-style textures (albedo, normal and emission maps) on a real vanilla material.
- Item displays copy each survivor's real placement for a similar vanilla item (void items use their original's spot), scaled to match.
- Every proc and equipment has a vanilla sound, heard by all players in multiplayer; aura items show a radius ring; Umbrella rains; Decaying Sample and Filial Imprinting use their own models.
- Balance pass against vanilla items of the same tier: Meat Nugget, Barbed Wire, Voltaic Mitt, Decaying Sample, AtG Mk. 2 and Explorer's Key toned down; Ol' Lopper, Photon Jetpack, Time Keeper's Secret, Filial Imprinting, Legendary Spark, Ifrit's Horn and Imp Overlord's Tentacle buffed; Old Box moved to Uncommon; void-item buffs capped.
- Built against the current game version; fixed 8 asset paths that no longer existed.
- Lunar rework: every lunar item and equipment with a downside keeps its trade-off with a gentler penalty (Shaped Glass, Transcendence, both Fluxes, Purity, Neutronium, Brittle Crown, Gouge, Corpsebloom, Egocentrism, Convergence, Gesture, Heresy, Rachis, Solitude, Meteorite, Helfire, Effigy, Tonic). Each change can be toggled and tuned.
- Harder lunar acquisition: pricier pods and Bazaar, fewer coin drops, fewer pods, plus optional Bazaar-only and trade-in modes. One switch turns it all off.
- Renamed to ror2-plus.
- ror2-plus is now a game expansion: it has its own emblem and an on/off switch in the lobby's Expansions row, like the official DLCs.
- Every unlock has its own challenge icon, painted in the same style as the base game's item unlocks.
